command:
set -euo pipefail
git fetch origin
git checkout integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903
git reset --hard origin/integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903
[ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "a5ad4d5cf5d9faf8c12de571ea088a4b6e2893e3" ]
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
roots=[Path('managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include')]
needles=['typedef struct esp_zigbee_config','esp_zigbee_config_t','report_attr_cmd_req','report_attr_cmd']
for root in roots:
    for p in root.rglob('*.h'):
        try: s=p.read_text()
        except: continue
        if any(n in s for n in needles):
            lines=s.splitlines()
            for i,line in enumerate(lines):
                if any(n in line for n in needles):
                    lo=max(0,i-18); hi=min(len(lines),i+45)
                    print(f'=== {p}:{i+1} ===')
                    print('\n'.join(lines[lo:hi]))
PY
